Connect to the database

db_connection.Rd

Opens a connection to the SQL Server database via ODBC. Accepts either a pre-built connection string, or individual connection parameters which are assembled into one automatically.

Usage

db_connection(
  connection_string = NULL,
  driver = "SQL Server",
  server = "noufamesql04",
  database = "FISH_MASTER",
  ...
)

Arguments

connection_string

A complete ODBC connection string. If supplied, this is used as-is and all other arguments are ignored. Defaults to NULL, in which case a string is built from driver, server and database.

driver

ODBC driver name. Defaults to "SQL Server", a generic driver name available on most platforms without needing a specific driver version installed.

server

Server hostname. Defaults to "noufamesql04".

database

Database name. Defaults to "FISH_MASTER".

...

Additional named arguments passed on to DBI::dbConnect().

Value

A DBIConnection object representing the open connection.

Details

Callers are responsible for disconnecting the connection (e.g. with DBI::dbDisconnect()) once finished, or wrapping usage with on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(con)).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Default: built from driver/server/database
con <- db_connection()

# Fully custom connection string
con <- db_connection(
  connection_string = "driver=SQL Server;server=noufamesql04;database=FISH_MASTER"
)

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
} # }
